prs.title: Gross-up discount helper (division by zero at percent=100)
prs.diff:
diff --git a/payments.py b/payments.py
--- a/payments.py
+++ b/payments.py
@@ -36,5 +36,12 @@
     return [record_transaction(conn, payer, share, status="settled") for payer in payer_ids]
 
 
+def apply_discount(amount_cents: int, percent: int) -> int:
+    """Amount to charge so that after `percent`% off the merchant still nets `amount_cents`."""
+    if percent < 0:
+        raise ValueError("percent must be non-negative")
+    return amount_cents * 100 // (100 - percent)
+
+
 def format_amount(amount_cents: int) -> str:
     return f"${amount_cents / 100:,.2f}"
